page_title: MNU 3-2 FUL | Manchester Utd v Fulham 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' That's it for today, John Brooks has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+11' John Brooks blows his whistle. Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) commits a foul after dangerous play. There is a free kick near the sideline to Fulham.
90+10' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
90+8' Harry Wilson (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+6' Substitution. Bryan Mbeumo walks off the pitch and Leny Yoro (Manchester United) comes on as a substitute.
90+4' 3 - 2 It's 3:2! Bruno Fernandes feeds Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the top right corner.
90+1' 2 - 2 Goal! Kevin (Fulham) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the top right corner.
90' The fourth official shows 9 min. of added time.
88' The statistic for corner kicks – 3:7.
86' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Jorge Cuenca is replaced by Calvin Bassey (Fulham).
86' Substitution. Diogo Dalot is replaced by Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United).
85' 2 - 1 Goal! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) directs his penalty into the top left corner and past Senne Lammens.
85' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
83' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Harry Maguire (Manchester United).
83' A clumsy foul by Harry Maguire (Manchester United) and John Brooks blows his whistle. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Fulham!
82' Harry Wilson (Fulham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
82' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

82' The ball is crossed into the box and Raul Jimenez (Fulham) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the left side of the goal, but Senne Lammens gets a glove on it to thwart him. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
81' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
79' It will be a substitution. Tom Cairney (Fulham) is ready to enter the pitch as Samuel Chukwueze walks off.
78' The corner from Alex Iwobi (Fulham) is hurriedly cleared.
76' Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the left post with a fine header. What a chance!
75' Michael Carrick has decided to substitute Casemiro and he is replaced by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United).
74' Substitution. Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) replaces Matheus Cunha.
74' A wild pass somehow finds Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
72' That's unlucky! Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
71' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Emile Smith Rowe will be replaced by Kevin (Fulham).
71' The game has come to an end for Antonee Robinson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham).
71' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) commits a foul and John Brooks immediately signals a free kick.
69' Celebrations are cut short for Fulham as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
67' Wait! Referee John Brooks has indicated he is going to review the Fulham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
65' It's in the back of the net! Jorge Cuenca (Fulham) gets on the end of a brilliant pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net by striking the ball past the goalkeeper!
65' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
64' Casemiro (Manchester United) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
62' Rough tackle by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' John Brooks interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham).
58' The current number of shots on goal is 5:3.
56' 2 - 0 Goal! Casemiro manages to prod the ball to Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the roof of the net. 2:0.
55' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
53' Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

52' Harry Wilson (Fulham) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the middle of the goal but is denied by Senne Lammens, who pulls off a comfortable save!
51' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Fulham are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
50' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.

49' He should have scored! Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Bernd Leno makes an easy save.
48' Manchester Utd are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
46' The whistle blows and John Brooks starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
45+3' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
45+3' Sander Berge (Fulham) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
45+2' A raking crossfield pass from Harry Maguire (Manchester United) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
42' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. John Brooks had an easy-decision to make.
42' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
40' A long pass finds Alex Iwobi (Fulham), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the bottom left corner, but Senne Lammens reacts well to make a good save.
38' Dangerous play by Timothy Castagne (Fulham). John Brooks blows his whistle for a foul.
36' He should have scored! Harry Wilson (Fulham) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
34' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
32' The resulting corner from Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is cleared.
30' Bernd Leno displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
28' The Manchester Utd players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
24' A cross by Luke Shaw (Manchester United) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
22' The ball possession at the moment is 48:52.
20' Referee John Brooks has finally had enough of Marco Silva and brandishes a yellow card at him!

19' 1 - 0 Casemiro (Manchester United) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space inside the box to meet the free kick and powers a perfectly placed header inside the right post.
19' The Manchester Utd players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee John Brooks. NO PENALTY!
17' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Manchester Utd using VAR. Let's see what happens.
16' Referee John Brooks sees the trip by Jorge Cuenca (Fulham) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. PENALTY to Manchester Utd!
14' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
14' Senne Lammens pulls off a great save to deny Joachim Andersen (Fulham), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the left side of the goal. Fulham earn a corner.
13' Harry Wilson (Fulham) works the corner short.
12' Fulham are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
10' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
9' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his low effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
9' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) is about to take a corner kick.
8' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Amad Diallo (Manchester United). The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
7' Harry Wilson (Fulham) is flagged for offside.

5' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Bernd Leno pulls off an easy save.
4' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
2' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Fulham will have the kick-off.
John Brooks is introduced as the referee for today's match.
